product.name: 600mm Wall Hung Bathroom Vanity Unit with Basin, Grey Gloss, 2 Soft Close Drawers
product.description:
The Sonix 600mm wall hung vanity unit does the essentials well: a clean ceramic basin on top, two soft-close drawers underneath, and a grey high-gloss finish that catches the light.

The front and sides are finished in solid acrylic, giving a mirror-like gloss that's water-resistant and easy to keep clean. Polished chrome handles sit neatly against the grey, and European drawer runners mean both drawers glide smoothly and quietly, built to handle daily use for years.

Wall-hung to free up floor space, the Sonix keeps your bathroom feeling open while giving you proper storage beneath the basin. The ceramic basin features a single tap hole with a central waste position, ready to plumb in.

Specification

Dimensions: 548mm (H) x 610mm (W) x 460mm (D)
Material: MDF carcass with solid acrylic front/sides
Finish: Grey high-gloss
Hardware: Polished chrome handles
Drawers: 2 x soft-close, European runners
Basin: Ceramic, single tap hole, central waste
Guarantee: 5 years

product.name: Aurora Aurum Veler Effect Tongue & Groove Waterproof Shower Wall Panel (H)2420mm (W)1180mm
product.description:
The Aurora boards are a sleek, modern alternative to traditional tiling, offering the perfect combination of design and durability. Made with a 100% waterproof synthetic homogenous foam blend core, they are not only water-resistant but also a more environmentally conscious option compared to polymer-based boards.

Once installed, Aurora boards require minimal upkeep. Simply wipe them down with a damp cloth to keep them looking fresh. The non-porous surface prevents water retention, helping to eliminate issues like mould and bacteria growth often associated with traditional tiles.

Transform your shower, bathroom, or kitchen with this low maintenance, sleek waterproof wall panel. Measuring 2420mm in height and a generous 1180mm wide, that can be cut down to your required size, these panels offer a perfect fit for any space, providing both practicality and style.

The tongue & groove connection ensures a seamless, easy-to-assemble installation with no grouting needed! The panels simply click together to create a smooth watertight finish with no long drying time required.

The waterproof & mould-resistant surface is ideal for wet areas like showers and bathrooms that can be easily cleaned after each use. 

These stylish, high-quality panels are designed to provide a modern, clean finish to your space while being incredibly easy to install and maintain. Say goodbye to grout and mould with this perfect solution for a fast and fresh update!

product.name: Hoses UK 25mm Clear PVC Corrugated Flexible Water Butt Hose 1m Reinforced Downpipe Connector Rainwater Harvesting Pump Pond
product.description: The Hoses UK Clear PVC Corrugated Water Butt & Pond Hose is a lightweight, UV-resistant and flexible hose designed for water transfer, pond circulation, and general fluid handling. Its transparent design allows easy monitoring of water or fluid movement, making it ideal for applications that benefit from visual inspection. Manufactured with a smooth PVC inner wall and a corrugated PVC outer layer, the hose incorporates a high-tensile plastic rib reinforcement to provide durability and crush resistance while maintaining flexibility. The clear corrugated PVC hose is designed for medium-duty environments requiring a crush-resistant, UV-stable, and easy-to-handle flexible hose. Operating from -10 degrees C to +65 degrees C (peak +70 degrees C) and compliant with BS EN ISO 3994-2001, this corrugated PVC hose provides reliability, resilience, and ease of use in a variety of light to medium-duty environments. Key features include a smooth bore for consistent water or fluid flow, a flexible corrugated exterior for efficient fluid transfer, and a tough plastic rib reinforcement that resists crushing and maintains flow integrity under mechanical stress. The transparent construction allows operators to monitor flow and detect blockages or contamination quickly, which is particularly useful in pond systems, aquatics, and industrial water circulation. This hose is also widely used for workshop water transfer and light chemical solutions where visibility and flexible installation are essential. Available in a range of sizes with internal diameters from 19 mm to 50 mm and wall thicknesses from 2 mm to 4 mm, the Hoses UK Clear PVC Corrugated Water Butt & Pond Hose is suitable for a variety of applications including pond and aquarium circulation, garden water features, drainage systems, irrigation setups, and light industrial fluid handling tasks.

product.description:
Anti-slip Strips for Wet Zones - Various Options
These anti-slip strips as wet zone coverings are ideal for eliminating slip hazards in areas where people walk barefoot or where it is constantly wet. On the bare soles of the feet, the anti-slip strips with rounded and tapered corners feel pleasant and provide a secure grip on slippery floors, such as those in swimming pools, saunas, changing rooms or even in your home in the bathtub or shower. The versatile adhesive strips with anti-slip function can also be used as swimming pool edging or as a non-slip underlay for water sports equipment. By distributing several anti-slip strips, even larger surfaces can be made non-slip. The anti-slip wet zone covering in the form of adhesive strips is ideally suited for all smooth surfaces and floors, such as tiled and stone floors or surfaces made of metal, wood or plastic.
The white and transparent anti-slip stickers are hardly noticeable and blend in visually. The anti-slip, self-adhesive anti-slip covering for wet zones is available in different colours, sizes and sets and is very easy to apply. The wet zone covering is also available as a complete roll with a length of 18.3 metres. In addition, the self-adhesive, waterproof and strongly adhesive anti-slip strips are largely resistant to cleaning agents, are tear-resistant and have a high abrasion resistance.

Material: PVC
Colours: White, Transparent
Various sizes, sets or as a complete roll (18.3 m)

product.name: Pegdev Detectable Mesh (Gas Pipe) Durable Underground Service Marker 200mm x 26m
product.description: Pegdev Detectable Gas Pipe Mesh is designed to provide a clear and highly visible warning for buried underground gas pipes during excavation work. This durable warning mesh is suitable for contractors, builders, utility companies, landscapers and groundworkers working on construction and excavation projects. The mesh is rot resistant and manufactured from durable HDPE to withstand demanding underground conditions, providing a long-lasting solution for underground service identification. product.name: GreenteQ Orion 3 Star Thumbturn Euro Cylinder - 50/40 (90mm), Brass
product.description: Premium quality anti-snap thumbturn euro cylinder, offering maximum protection against lock snapping, bumping, and other common attack methods. Provides full TS007 3-star protection and peace of mind to the outside, and convenience of a twist lock on the inside. Thumbturn cylinders are great for regular use doors, as they provide convenient internal locking and unlocking, without the need to have keys at hand. These cylinders feature a sacrificial breakpoint, which releases the external side of the cylinder during a snap attack, leaving the cam protected, and engaging an interlocking mechanism that prevents further damage to the lock. A button on the thumbturn knob allows the lock to be operated from the inside following an attacke. Offered with a 10 year performance warranty, and 10 year proteQ10 security guarantee.

product.name: 8mm 45 Degree Plastic Hose Connector Black Barbed Hose Connector for Garden Hoses, Pond Hoses, Water Pipes
product.description: This 45 Degree Plastic Hose Connector is a practical solution for creating smooth, angled connections between hoses. Manufactured from tough, lightweight ABS plastic, it offers excellent durability and resistance to weathering, corrosion, and everyday wear. The 45-degree design helps reduce hose stress while maintaining steady water flow, making it particularly useful in spaces where a gentle directional change is required. With its barbed ends, the connector ensures a firm grip on the hose, preventing leaks and slippage even when used under pressure. Perfect for use with garden hoses, pond hoses, aquarium setups, or general water systems, this connector supports efficient water management in both domestic and professional settings. Quick and easy to install, simply push the hose ends over the barbs to achieve a secure, watertight seal. Whether used in irrigation, pond filtration, or household water projects, it helps maintain neat and organised hose routing while protecting hoses from kinking. Combining reliability, strength, and ease of use, this connector is an essential accessory for gardeners, pond enthusiasts, and DIY users who need a cost-effective and long-lasting way to manage hose connections effectively.

product.name: Double Tap Connector with Valves & 4mm Micro Barb Outlets
product.description:
The Double Tap Connector with Valves & Threaded Outlets in Black/Orange is a versatile and efficient solution for managing water flow from a single source. Designed with a 1 BSP Female and 3/4 BSP Female inlet, this connector is compatible with most standard taps and water sources. It provides two separate 3/4 BSP Male outlets, allowing users to direct water to multiple locations or devices simultaneously, making it an ideal choice for garden irrigation, outdoor cleaning, or other water distribution needs.
One of the key features of this connector is its independent control valves, which enable precise flow regulation for each outlet. Whether you need full pressure on one side and a trickle on the other, the adjustable valves allow for customized water flow to meet specific requirements. This functionality ensures that you can efficiently manage your water usage, minimize waste and maximize the effectiveness of your watering or cleaning tasks.
Constructed from strong, durable plastic, the Double Tap Connector is built to withstand the rigors of outdoor use. Its robust design ensures longevity, even in challenging weather conditions. The contrasting black and orange colour scheme not only provides a sleek, modern appearance but also makes the connector easy to spot and operate in various environments.

product.name: 4"  camlock cam & groove layflat hose fittings type A, female bsp thread pump connector
product.description:
Camlock Type A fittings are a type of quick-connect coupling commonly used in fluid transfer systems. These fittings consist of a male adaptor with a male thread on one end and a camlock (grooved) connection on the other. The male thread allows the fitting to be connected to a female-threaded pipe or hose, while the camlock connection is designed to quickly and securely connect to a female camlock coupler (Types B, C, D, or DC).

Material: Camlock Type A fittings are typically made from a variety of materials, including aluminum, stainless steel, brass, and polypropylene, depending on the application requirements.

Sizes: These fittings are available in a range of sizes, typically from ½ inch to 6 inches, to accommodate different hose and pipe diameters.

Design Features:

Male Adaptor: One end has a male threaded adaptor, which can be screwed into a female-threaded component.
Grooved End: The opposite end features the camlock design, which includes a groove that allows the female camlock coupler to latch securely onto it using cam arms.
Uses of Camlock Type A Fittings:
Camlock Type A fittings are used in a wide range of industries due to their versatility and ease of use. Here are some common applications:

Fluid Transfer Systems:

Used in the transfer of liquids, including water, chemicals, petroleum products, and fuels, from one container or pipe to another.
Agriculture:

Employed in irrigation systems, pesticide spraying, and transferring liquid fertilizers.
Chemical Processing:

Utilized in industries where chemicals are transferred between tanks, pipes, and machinery.
Food and Beverage Industry:

Used in sanitary applications for transferring liquids like juices, milk, and other food-grade substances, especially when made from stainless steel or other sanitary materials.
Petroleum Industry:

Essential in the transfer of fuels and other petroleum-based liquids, where a secure, leak-proof connection is crucial.

product.name: DIYUK W2 Stainless Steel Worm Drive Hose Clips, Adjustable Pipe Clamps, 190-210mm, Pack of 10
product.description:
Need a secure, adjustable grip on a hose, pipe or duct? These W2 stainless steel worm drive hose clips clamp flexible hose, pipe and ducting onto spigots and barbed or ridged fittings: HVAC and ducting connections, domestic and agricultural plumbing, including washing machine drain hoses, and workshop and light industrial hose and pipe fastening. They work as metal hose clamps, hose pipe clamps, stainless steel pipe clamps and duct clamps. This pack contains 10 hose clips in the 190-210mm size.

The band and housing are stainless steel for strong resistance to rust and general weathering, with a zinc-plated steel hex-head screw with a combined slot and cross drive, so it takes a flat-blade or cross-head screwdriver.

The worm drive engages an embossed band 9mm wide and 0.7mm thick for fine, even tightening across the full clamping range, and the slim band keeps the clip low-profile once fitted. The clamping range is embossed on every band, so each size is easy to identify. A recommended tightening torque of 4.0 Nm (approx. 35 lbf in) guides correct fitting.

Grade: W2

Recommended tightening torque: 4.0 Nm

product.name: Fullex Kinetica+ K4 3-Star Euro Cylinder - Chrome, 40/40 (80mm), 2 Extra (5 total)
product.description: High security TS007 3-Star Kinetica+ euro cylinder combining advanced anti-snap, anti-bump, anti-drill, anti-pick and anti-plug pull protection with its revolutionary anti-tilt cam and sprung anti-grip drive bar. Recognised as leading the field in euro cylinder security, Kinetica+ is Secured by Design accredited and provides outstanding resistance against lock-snapping attacksvia several defensive mechanisms: A sacrificial cut ensures the cylinder snaps in front of the vulnerable cam area, and at the moment of failure, an anti-grip drive bar springs forward, and is stopped by dual attack rods that fire sideways. The rotating cam moves independantly, and stops when its outer defence ring hits the barrels. Dual attack rods limit the space attacker can work in, making it impossible to push the drive bar backwards to release the cam. The attacker will also fail to grab the drive bar, due to the bars tapered anti-grip ends. Leaving no way of manipulating or removing the cam. An innovative anti-tilt mechanism prevents the cam section from lowering when the cylinder is snapped, reducing further the space an attacker has to manipulate the mechanism. Following a snap attack, Kinetica+ leaves the lock protected on the outside, and operational on the inside. IMPORTANT SIZE INFORMATION: Kinetica+ cylinder size is represented with the external measurement first, and internal measurement second. Size should be measured from face of cylinder to centre of screw hole. If your cylinder measures 35mm from outside face to centre of screw hole, and 45mm from centre of screw hole to inside face (80mm overall), then you should order a 35/45 (80mm) cylinder.

product.name: Westco 15mm Compression Brass BS Gate Valve - Easy Fit Lockshield Isolating Valve for Heating, No Soldering Needed
product.description: Need to shut off or balance the water flow to a radiator or pipe run without calling a plumber? This Westco 15mm compression brass BS gate valve is a straightforward way to do it. It has 15mm compression connections at both ends, so it fits onto standard 15mm copper pipe with a spanner and no soldering, blowtorch or special tools. It is a lockshield gate valve, which means the cap helps prevent accidental adjustment between services once the system has been set up. That makes it a sensible choice for isolating and balancing water flow in central heating and domestic plumbing systems, where gate valves are a standard fitting in UK installations. The solid brass body is built for strength and long-term reliability, and the gate valve design gives positive shut-off when you need to isolate part of the system for repairs, replacing a radiator or draining down a section of pipework. It is suitable for hot and cold water systems, so it works equally well on heating flow and return pipework and on general domestic plumbing. Whether you are a weekend DIYer swapping an old valve, a landlord keeping a rental property maintained, or a first-time buyer tackling a simple plumbing job, the 15mm compression size is the one to look for on typical 15mm copper pipework. Check your pipe size before you buy: this valve is for 15mm pipe only.

product.description:
This Plastic 45 Degree Reducer Barbed Joiner is designed to connect two hoses of different internal diameters while providing a smooth 45° directional change. The barbed ends provide a secure push-fit connection inside flexible hose, helping to minimise leaks and maintain consistent flow. The reducer design enables connection between two different hose sizes without the need for additional adapters.

The 45-degree angle supports improved hose routing compared to straight connectors, helping reduce kinking and stress on pipework. Suitable for use with PVC hose, rubber hose, and other flexible pipe systems, this joiner performs reliably in outdoor and wet environments. Resistant to water and general wear, it provides dependable performance for both DIY users and professional installers. Whether adapting hose sizes or changing direction within a system, this reducer barbed joiner offers a practical and efficient solution.
